name: Skeleton to result reveal
looks: A chat input receives a typed request, then a soft blank placeholder block appears exactly where a result will land, with a small working spinner or pulse. The placeholder resolves in place into the finished asset, cross-fading within its own bounds rather than popping in elsewhere.
build: Placeholder is a flat rounded rect a few percent off its ground, opacity pulsing 0.85-1 over ~1.2s. Result asset is pre-sized to the same bounding box. The result cross-fades in over the placeholder (300-500ms, power1.out) at identical bounds; the placeholder fades out in the same window, no layout shift.
sound: A soft low pulse under the working hold, a brighter chime exactly as the result resolves in.
prompt: Show a request typed into a chat input, then a soft placeholder block appearing exactly where the result will sit, pulsing gently to read as working. Resolve the placeholder into the finished asset in place, cross-fading within the same bounds so nothing shifts in the layout.
